notes.title: Back Broken Relic on Kickstarter!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

Today the Broken Relic Kickstarter is live! If you’ve enjoyed the demo or you’re excited about a new pixel-art point-and-click, this is the moment to jump in and back the campaign!

What you’ll find on the Kickstarter:

-Digital editions for day-one players
- Retro big-box options for collectors
- Limited NPC cameos for superfans

Your support on day one has a huge impact on momentum and visibility! Thank you for backing, sharing, and helping bring this adventure to life!

Back Broken Relic on Kickstarter → https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/broken-relic/broken-relic

notes.title: Broken Relic Discord is open!
notes.content:
Broken Relic – Community Hub Now Live


Hey everyone!

The public Discord server is open. Join to:

• 🛠️ report bugs and share suggestions  
• 📺 catch WIP GIFs, concept art, and dev streams  
• 📰 get notified of news before anyone else

(I mean, its a Discord, just to talk and chill!)

▶ DISCORD LINK ◀  (click to join instantly)



Newsletter sign-up
Prefer email? Register to our newsletter to stay up to date for just the big news.

Newsletter → https://www.brokenrelic.com/

If you like the direction so far, a quick Wishlist helps the project more than you’d think. Thanks for the support! see you in Discord!



Some Demo Patch Notes
• Fixed hotspot issue staying between rooms
• Fixed bug with graphical artefacts that made everything look quite ugly
• Some other minor bugs here and there
